macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and major altcoins surge on Treasury liquidity move and Trump crypto push
items.summary: Bitcoin rose 7.7% to around $68,945 and briefly hit $69,749, while Ethereum jumped 17.8% above $2,235; XRP and Solana each gained about 10% as the total crypto market cap climbed 8.1% to $2.47 trillion. The rally followed the U.S. Treasury’s decision to double long-term bond buybacks and President Trump’s meeting with crypto executives and support for the CLARITY Act.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly tops $70,000 as falling yields and Trump meeting lift sentiment
items.summary: Bitcoin crossed the $70,000 level for the first time in over two months and later traded above $71,900 in a move driven by lower U.S. yields, Trump’s meeting with crypto leaders, and strong ETF inflows. The surge also lifted several altcoins and triggered heavy liquidations across leveraged crypto positions.

items.title: Crypto market adds nearly $190 billion after Trump’s crypto summit and Treasury buyback move
items.summary: Bitcoin jumped nearly 11% to around $71,730, Ethereum rose to about $2,285, and major altcoins rallied sharply, adding almost $190 billion to total crypto market capitalization. The move came alongside more than $2.74 billion in short-position liquidations.

items.title: Trump urges Congress to pass CLARITY Act as Bitcoin breaks above $71,000
items.summary: Bitcoin rose sharply after Trump called on Congress to pass the CLARITY Act, reinforcing optimism about regulatory clarity for digital assets. The rally coincided with Treasury debt buyback news that improved risk appetite and pushed crypto prices higher.

items.title: Hyperliquid token jumps 23% on report U.S. may consider allowing platform operations
items.summary: A token linked to offshore exchange Hyperliquid climbed 23% in 24 hours after reports that the U.S. is exploring options for allowing the derivatives platform to operate domestically. The move highlights how regulatory speculation is driving sharp single-token gains.

items.title: Market recap says SEC floated a proposed ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ framework
items.summary: A CryptoRank market recap reported that the SEC introduced a proposed ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ framework aimed at creating a more specific regulatory path for crypto-related capital formation. The same recap said the policy backdrop and Treasury liquidity move helped fuel a broad market breakout.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly pauses frontier model training over cyber risk
items.summary: OpenAI has reportedly slowed or paused training on its newest frontier models after internal testing suggested its upcoming Astra model may cross a critical cybersecurity threshold in the company’s Preparedness Framework. The move underscores rising industry caution around model misuse and safety controls.

items.title: Stripe reportedly agrees to acquire OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
items.summary: Stripe has reportedly finalized a deal to buy OpenRouter, the AI model-routing marketplace used by developers to access competing models through one API. The acquisition signals continued consolidation in the AI infrastructure layer.

items.title: Google and Marvell expand custom AI chip deal tied to a $12.2 billion warrant
items.summary: Google reportedly took a warrant on up to 59 million Marvell shares as part of an expanded custom AI chip supply agreement. The news highlights how hyperscalers are deepening direct partnerships for specialized AI silicon.

items.title: Nvidia reportedly backs OpenAI’s Ohio data-centre buildout with up to $105 billion guarantee
items.summary: Nvidia is said to be guaranteeing land, power, and buildout for OpenAI’s new Ohio data-centre project, marking a major shift from chip supplier to capital partner. The reported scale of the commitment reflects the intensifying race to secure compute for frontier AI.

items.title: Meta ships first Meta AI desktop app for Mac
items.summary: Meta has launched its first Meta AI desktop app for macOS, adding features such as screen sharing and system-wide dictation. The release shows Meta broadening its consumer AI product surface beyond mobile and web.

items.title: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing for enterprise abuse detection
items.summary: OpenAI is previewing a privacy-focused safety feature that monitors enterprise AI usage for potential abuse across multiple conversations while retaining none of the customer’s underlying data. The announcement points to a broader trend toward enterprise safety tooling and privacy-preserving oversight.

items.title: Anthropic reportedly surpasses OpenAI in second-quarter sales
items.summary: Reports say Anthropic’s revenue has overtaken OpenAI’s in the second quarter, driven by enterprise adoption of Claude Code and reported operating profit. If confirmed, the shift would indicate strong demand for coding-focused AI tools in business settings.

items.title: DeepSeek and Google highlight fast-moving price competition in model APIs
items.summary: Market reports say DeepSeek raised API prices while Google cut prices on a newer model, intensifying competition in foundation-model pricing. The moves reflect a broader industry trend toward margin pressure and rapid price undercutting.

items.title: Daily AI coverage highlights stronger focus on security, infrastructure, and enterprise adoption
items.summary: Across the day’s AI coverage, the dominant themes were model safety, compute infrastructure, and enterprise deployment rather than consumer chatbots alone. Reported developments also included data-centre expansion, custom silicon deals, and privacy-aware safety features.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass August Wave 2 lineup announced
items.summary: Microsoft has revealed its next Xbox Game Pass batch for August 2026, including a mix of indie titles and day-one releases. The lineup also includes Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy for Ultimate and PC subscribers.

items.title: Mortal Shell II launches today
items.summary: The sequel to Mortal Shell is among the day’s notable releases, drawing attention ahead of its launch. Coverage highlights strong pre-release buzz from influencers and genre fans.

items.title: STALKER 2 expansion arrives
items.summary: STALKER 2: Cost of Hope is listed as a major non-linear expansion for the 2024 role-playing game, landing on PC and console. The release is part of a broader slate of notable game launches and updates.

items.title: Esports Nations Cup delayed to 2027
items.summary: The inaugural Esports Nations Cup has reportedly been pushed back until 2027 because of the wider regional situation. The delay affects plans to add a new international competition to the esports calendar.

items.title: Roblox faces U.S. Senate scrutiny over child safety
items.summary: Roblox is under investigation by the bipartisan Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Crime and Counterterrorism over child safety concerns. Lawmakers cited the platform’s reported cases of suspected child sexual exploitation in a letter to CEO David Baszucki.

items.title: Apple proposes lower outside-payment fee in court
items.summary: Apple has proposed charging developers a 15% fee for purchases made outside its store, with a lower 5% rate for small businesses. The filing adds to ongoing industry scrutiny over app-store policies.

items.title: New Black Myth: Zhong Kui gameplay demo trends in China
items.summary: Game Science has released a new 15-minute gameplay demonstration for Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the second entry in the Black Myth series. The reveal quickly climbed Chinese trending charts.
